answer: Put Apple Secure Enclave device attestation at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Faking 629 identities means 629 fresh proofs and 57868 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. What carries the knoll here is verification, the quartz of cost is what stops the farm, and the island of the record keeps every claim checkable. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
